:::{#exr-translation-practice}
#### Finding the translation that moves one point to another

A [translation](#def-translation) moves every point by the same vector,
so where it sends one point fixes the whole translation.
A translation $t_{\vec{b}}$ of $\reals^2$ sends $\tp{(2, 3)}$ to $\tp{(5, 1)}$.

Find $\vec{b}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Solve $\tp{(2, 3)} + \vec{b} = \tp{(5, 1)}$ entry by entry.

:::

:::
